point: A deposit secures a date: it makes the booking certain.
訂金 secures 日期：讓這一天確定留給你。
why: The third paragraph of the web page is the booking policy: Please book at least ten days in advance. A deposit of 25 percent of the estimated food cost secures your date. Once the deposit is paid, the caterer keeps that date for you and no one else can take it. So secures means guarantees.
網頁第 3 段是訂餐規定：Please book at least ten days in advance. A deposit of 25 percent of the estimated food cost secures your date。付了訂金，外燴就把這一天留給你，別人訂不走。所以 secures 的意思是 guarantees（確保）。

point: Purpose: find what the writer asks the caterer to do.
目的題：找出寫信人要外燴做什麼。
why: The first paragraph of the e-mail says we are coming back to you for our spring training day. The second paragraph asks please put us down for the package that includes them and gives about 30 people, and the third gives the date and asks for the food by 11:30. The whole e-mail books lunch for the training day, so it was sent to order catering for a staff event.

e-mail 第 1 段說 we are coming back to you for our spring training day。第 2 段請對方 please put us down for the package that includes them，並給了 about 30 people；第 3 段談日期，也希望餐點 by 11:30 送到。整封信都在為訓練日訂午餐，所以目的是為員工活動訂外燴。

point: Name the package from what it includes, then compare it with January.
從內容認出是哪個套餐，再跟一月那次比。
why: The first paragraph of the e-mail says the January lunch was the Harvest Package. The second paragraph says colleagues have asked for dessert and coffee and asks for the package that includes them. In the second paragraph of the web page, only the Banquet Package has a dessert table and coffee service, and it is the Harvest Package plus a second hot main course, so it has two hot main courses and the Harvest Package has one. The invoice's first row, 34 guests at $26.00, matches the Banquet price. So this lunch had more main dishes than the one in January.

e-mail 第 1 段說一月那次是 the Harvest Package。第 2 段說同事 have asked for dessert and coffee，所以要 the package that includes them。網頁第 2 段中，只有 Banquet Package 有 a dessert table and coffee service，而它是 Harvest Package plus a second hot main course，也就是兩道熱的主菜，Harvest 只有一道。發票第一行 34 guests at $26.00 也正是 Banquet 的價錢。所以這次的主菜比一月多。

point: Match the invoice line to the policy, then to the e-mail.
把發票那一行對回訂餐規定，再對回 e-mail。
why: The invoice's second row is Delivery, Flat fee, $35.00. The third paragraph of the web page says Delivery is free anywhere within Corbridge city limits; a flat fee of $35 applies to all other addresses. The first paragraph of the e-mail says we have since left our Corbridge premises; our new office is at 14 Mill Lane in Ashby. Ashby is outside Corbridge, so the fee applies: the company moved to an address outside the free-delivery area.

發票第二行是 Delivery、Flat fee、$35.00。網頁第 3 段說 Delivery is free anywhere within Corbridge city limits; a flat fee of $35 applies to all other addresses。e-mail 第 1 段說 we have since left our Corbridge premises; our new office is at 14 Mill Lane in Ashby。Ashby 不在 Corbridge，所以要收這筆運費：公司搬到了免運範圍以外的地址。

point: Three documents: the $60 line tells you which day it was.
三篇整合：$60 那一行告訴你是哪一天。
why: The invoice's third row is Staffing, Service team surcharge, $60.00. The third paragraph of the web page says Events held on a Saturday or Sunday carry an additional $60 staffing charge, so the training was on a weekend. In the third paragraph of the e-mail, Ms. Whitfield first proposes a weekday, We would like Thursday, March 20, and then adds If they run late, we will move the training to Saturday, March 22. So it took place on Saturday, March 22, two days later than first proposed.

發票第三行是 Staffing、Service team surcharge、$60.00。網頁第 3 段說 Events held on a Saturday or Sunday carry an additional $60 staffing charge，所以訓練辦在週末。e-mail 第 3 段，Whitfield 女士先提出平日：We would like Thursday, March 20，接著說 If they run late, we will move the training to Saturday, March 22。所以活動在 3 月 22 日星期六舉行，比最初提出的日期晚兩天。

The shop delivers free within city limits.
The garage charges a flat fee of ten dollars.
Smoking is not allowed anywhere on the premises.
Please put me down for two seats at the dinner.

The balance due must be paid within fourteen days.

point: Purpose: read past the greeting to the changes.
目的題：越過開頭的問候，看後面的變動。
why: The first paragraph of the e-mail only asks passengers to read the information below, so the purpose is in the paragraphs after it. The second paragraph replaces the boat stop: In its place, we will visit Hessle Farm Dairy. It also moves lunch and the return later than the itinerary shows. The third paragraph moves the departure to Bay 2. The fourth gives other choices to passengers who prefer not to travel because of the change. Paragraphs two to four all tell passengers how Saturday's tour differs from the itinerary, so the e-mail was sent to announce changes to a trip.

e-mail 第 1 段只請旅客 read the information below，所以目的要看後面的段落。第 2 段替換了搭船那一站：In its place, we will visit Hessle Farm Dairy，午餐和回程也比行程表所列的時間晚。第 3 段把出發地點改到 Bay 2。第 4 段給因此不想去的旅客其他選擇。第 2 到第 4 段都在告訴旅客週六的行程和行程表哪裡不一樣，所以寫信是為了通知行程變動。

point: An offer stands until a time: it is open until then.
offer stands until 某時：方案在那之前都有效。
why: The fourth paragraph of the e-mail gives the offer: you may cancel for a full refund or move to our Lakeside Day Tour on June 28 at no extra cost. The next sentence is This offer stands until 5:00 p.m. on Thursday, June 12. Passengers can take the offer now, and until gives the deadline. So stands means remains valid.

e-mail 第 4 段提出方案：you may cancel for a full refund or move to our Lakeside Day Tour on June 28 at no extra cost。下一句是 This offer stands until 5:00 p.m. on Thursday, June 12。旅客現在就可以選這個方案，until 給的是截止時間。所以 stands 的意思是 remains valid（仍然有效）。

point: Bay 6 is in the itinerary, but the e-mail moved the coach.
Bay 6 是行程表上的月台，但 e-mail 已經改了上車處。
why: The itinerary's first row gives the departure point as Kingsgate Bus Station, Bay 6. The third paragraph of the e-mail closes Bays 5 to 8 and says Your coach will therefore leave from Bay 2, beside the main ticket hall. The second paragraph of the review says an elderly couple had been waiting at Bay 6, and the driver had to go and find them. They went where the old itinerary told them to, so they relied on outdated departure details.

行程表第一行的出發地點是 Kingsgate Bus Station, Bay 6。e-mail 第 3 段說 5 到 8 號月台關閉，Your coach will therefore leave from Bay 2, beside the main ticket hall。評論第 2 段說 an elderly couple had been waiting at Bay 6，而 the driver had to go and find them。他們照舊的行程表去等車，所以是依據了過時的出發資訊。

point: Follow the dropped stop through all three documents.
沿著被取消的那一站，把三份文件串起來。
why: The first paragraph of the review says she booked mainly for the stop I had been looking forward to for months, and that Thornfield wrote to say it had been dropped. The second paragraph of the e-mail shows which stop was dropped: The boat that serves the island tea house on Lindell Water has been taken out of service, and In its place, we will visit Hessle Farm Dairy. The itinerary's third row describes the boat stop as a Forty-minute cruise to the island tea house, and the e-mail's fourth paragraph says some of you chose this tour for the lake. What she most looked forward to was a trip on a lake.

評論第 1 段說她報名主要是為了 the stop I had been looking forward to for months，而 Thornfield 來信 to say it had been dropped。e-mail 第 2 段說明取消的是哪一站：The boat that serves the island tea house on Lindell Water has been taken out of service，而且 In its place, we will visit Hessle Farm Dairy。行程表第三行說這一站是 Forty-minute cruise to the island tea house，e-mail 第 4 段也說 some of you chose this tour for the lake。所以她最期待的是遊湖。

point: NOT: find three options in the review; the fourth is only in the e-mail.
NOT 題：三個選項在評論裡找得到，剩下那個只出現在 e-mail。
why: The review confirms three options. Traveling with a relative: My sister and I booked this tour (first paragraph). Buying a product: I bought two wedges to take home (second paragraph); the wedges are pieces of cheese from the dairy stop. Being hungry before a meal: By the time we sat down at the inn, most of us were starving (third paragraph). A full refund appears only in the fourth paragraph of the e-mail, for passengers who cancel. Ms. Quaye writes We decided to go anyway, and she mentions my voucher, not a refund. So receiving a full refund is not mentioned in the review.

評論確認了三個選項。和親人同行：My sister and I booked this tour（第 1 段）。買了商品：I bought two wedges to take home（第 2 段）；wedges 是她在乳品場那一站買的兩塊乳酪。用餐前很餓：By the time we sat down at the inn, most of us were starving（第 3 段）。全額退款只出現在 e-mail 第 4 段，是給取消行程的人的。Quaye 女士寫 We decided to go anyway，她提到的是 my voucher，不是退款。所以評論沒有提到拿到全額退款。

Our accountant knows the tax rules inside out.
She cut the cheese into small wedges.
